vm2 VM#run executes the string argument inside a sandbox marketed as safe; vm2 is deprecated precisely because its escapes proved unfixable (host RCE), so untrusted code reaching it is a sandbox-escape lead
vm2 NodeVM#run compiles and runs the source string in a sandbox with the same known-unfixable escape exposure as VM#run
new VMScript(code) compiles untrusted source for a vm2 sandbox whose isolation has known host-RCE escapes
isolated-vm Context#eval runs the string in a V8 isolate; a reach is a sandbox-escape lead where the isolate boundary is bridged or a leaked Reference is callable
synchronous form of isolated-vm Context#eval; same isolate-boundary exposure
isolated-vm Context#evalClosure runs a closure body string with bound references; a reach is a sandbox-escape lead when the bound references reach host capabilities
isolated-vm Isolate#compileScript compiles untrusted source that a later Script#run executes in the isolate
safe-eval evaluates the string via a vm context with a timeout; documented-unsafe with public host-escape payloads, so treat it as eval
static-eval evaluate() interprets an expression AST derived from untrusted input; crafted ASTs achieve RCE (known CVEs)
